applicationStatusBarDescription: Show LSP status in the reorderable application status bar. If that bar is disabled or a touch-oriented layout is active, the editor toolbar is used instead.
chooseStatusLocation: Choose where LSP startup, indexing, and connection details appear.
crossFileDefinitionsMayBeIncomplete: Cross-file definitions and references may be incomplete while this work is active.
crossFileFeaturesAfterInitialization: Cross-file features become available after initialization completes.
crossFileFeaturesUnavailable: Cross-file features remain unavailable until initialization completes.
editorToolbarDescription: Show LSP status beside the active file's editor actions.
initializationLongRunning: Initialization is taking longer than usual
installKotlinLsp: Install kotlin-lsp on the task host, then restart the task.
kotlinInitializationGuidance: Kotlin LSP may be importing the Gradle project. Cross-file features remain unavailable until initialization completes.
noBackgroundWorkReportedDescription: The language server has not reported ongoing project analysis. Cross-file results may still warm up.
noPercentage: The server did not provide a percentage.
progressAppearsDuringInitialization: Project progress appears when language-server initialization begins.
progressUnavailableDescription: Retry the connection to receive project progress.
progressWillClear: Project progress will clear when the language server stops.
reportedWorkDisclaimer: This confirms only the reported work item, not full project indexing.
serverStillInitializing: The server process is still running while Kandev waits for LSP initialize.
startServerForProgress: Start the language server to receive project progress.
taskExecutorUnsupported: Language servers are not supported by this task executor
tooManyLanguageServers: Too many language servers are active
waitingForInitializeResponse: Waiting for the language server to respond to the LSP initialize request.
